mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% MoM and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months indicates a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases over three months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies report lower earnings.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases by more than 1% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals robust consumer demand, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth over 3 months
failure_condition: If RSAFS growth exceeds GDPC1 growth over a quarter and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong job growth, which boosts economic sentiment and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 MoM and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 25bps MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year growth rate of real GDP (GDPC1) exceeds 3%, it signals strong economic growth, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY growth exceeds 3% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.
